findings.title: Synchronous call in async function without await
findings.body: The new `converted_cents` function calls `fetch_rate` synchronously on line 16, but `fetch_rate` is an async function as shown in the signature excerpt. This will raise a `TypeError` at runtime because the async call is not awaited.

findings.title: Rounding floats instead of Decimals
findings.body: The function multiplies `amount_cents` (an int) by `rate` (a Decimal) and rounds the result to an int. This converts the Decimal to a float during multiplication, which can lose precision. Use `quantize` on the Decimal result instead.

summary.problem: The new async function performs synchronous calls and loses precision in money calculations.
summary.done_well: The function is clearly documented and uses the existing rate-fetching API.
